question_en: List the agreements on PUCCH resources.
original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'PUCCH' AND a.content CONTAINS 'resource' RETURN m.meetingNumber, a.resolutionId, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, a.resolutionId LIMIT 10
reference_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE coalesce(a.sourceRecordWindowText, a.content) CONTAINS 'PUCCH' AND coalesce(a.sourceRecordWindowText, a.content) CONTAINS 'resource' RETURN m.meetingNumber, a.resolutionId, coalesce(a.sourceRecordWindowText, a.content) AS content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, a.resolutionId LIMIT 10
